dog.description_text:
SHORT BIO
Hi everyone, I'm Commander! I just arrived and I'm already on a mission to sniff every single corner of my foster home. I'm a little bundle of energy who is super easy to carry around and I love being scooped up for the ride. I get along with other dogs too. When the adventures wind down I find the nearest pillow and burrow right in for a snuggle. I nap in hour long stretches and I'm not yet neutered.

PERSONALITY & CHARACTERISTICS

My foster dog is good with: Dogs (still getting to know him with Kids and Cats)

My foster dog is: working on house training, goes out every few hours. High energy and loves to play with his toys.

3 Keywords for your pup: Curious, Cuddly, Active

Energy Level (1 = calm, 10 = high energy): 8

Barker? Or Quiet Pup?: More of a crier than a barker. Only a couple of barks so far.

Walking Manners: Mostly prefers to be held but will walk for a little bit

Appetite: Big appetite! He loves his meals.

Favorite Things: Sniffing everything, being carried around, snuggling up on pillows and burrowing away

Commands/Tricks: Still learning. Working on settling down and napping.
dog.name: Commander Paylor (Commander)
